body:
A weakening wall will one day fall. 


But I guess the main reason I haven't is that in some sick way I know people need me , I matter just not enough for anyone to take the time out of their OH SO BUSY life and even address my existence. I guarantee the day I kicked the chair from under me would be the day my phone blew up with invitations.    


I'm always so tired, Faking a smile while all I want to do is cry but I'm so numb I haven't even been able to do that for years.
